about: Tiny teaching texts for the beginner lessons and the MLP journey. Written for NextWord (same licence as the project). Each has fixed train / validation / test parts. They are small enough to read every training example; they are for seeing how the model works, not for measuring how well it generalises.

datasets.name: abc pattern (tiny)
datasets.about: One rule only: a is followed by b, b by c, c by a. The held-out parts are the same pattern, so validation here checks the rule was learned, not that the model generalises.

datasets.name: cat and dog sentences (tiny)
datasets.about: Short sentences from a few words. No sentence appears in more than one part.

parts.train: the cat sat on the mat. the dog sat on the log. a cat ate a hat. the dog ran to the cat. a dog sat on a mat. the cat ran to the log.
parts.val: the dog ate the hat. a cat ran on a log.
parts.test: a dog ran to a hat. the cat sat on a log.

datasets.name: banana words (tiny)
datasets.about: Words made of b, a, n and d, so most letters have only a few possible followers. No line appears in more than one part.

parts.train: banana band. a bandana. nan and dad. a banana band. bad dan. an and a.
